profile.name: 安道尔科学相机
profile.description: 安道尔科学相机是一类高灵敏度实验室探测器，通常带有热电制冷功能，可用于低光信号检测与光谱采集。根据现有证据，该设备支持积分时间、快门、风扇、高增益、垂直分箱及探测器温度控制，常作为科研光谱系统中的探测器使用。
profile.description_en: An Andor scientific camera is a high-sensitivity laboratory detector, typically with thermoelectric cooling, used for low-light detection and spectral acquisition. Based on the available evidence, it supports integration time, shutter, fan, high-gain mode, vertical binning, and detector temperature control, and is commonly used as the detector in research spectroscopy systems.
